codeReview.summary: Pass. I reviewed the prior failed report for `70c2778`, the fix handoff/transcript for `b435fb8`, both commit diffs, and the resulting VNC code. The prior regression came from applying exact `/vnc` route matching inside the shared `useVncSessions()` hook, which also powers the visible `/vnc/session/:workflowId/:profileName` page. The fix commit resolves that by moving route gating to the grid container: `ProtectedLayoutShell` keeps cached routes visible only on exact path matches (`frontend/src/components/layout/ProtectedLayoutShell.tsx:29,64`), `VncPageContainer` now passes `useRouteActive('/vnc')` into `useVncSessions(isActive)` (`frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncPageContainer.tsx:13-14`), `useVncSessions(enabled)` gates both websocket/polling work on that explicit flag (`frontend/src/features/vnc/hooks/useVncSessions.ts:21,45,50,68`), and `VncSessionPageContainer` passes `true` so direct session loads still perform the initial refresh and stay subscribed (`frontend/src/features/vnc/containers/VncSessionPageContainer.tsx:30,62-70`). That adequately fixes the hidden-grid case and the direct session page case without introducing a new issue in the reviewed scope.
